**Target 1's formal part (proposal; a goal scope changes only with Ren).** The first target reads: "The deductive necessity of Becoming as a whole, with no added substantive axiom", explained as "that every becoming can be represented as the spine represents worlds, and that the whole is relationally constituted". No proof can settle the first clause as worded. Proposed restatement of the formal part: *every central law of the spine (K1) stated over every law, or relation, of exchange (`ExchangeLaw`, `ExchangeRelation`), with each `World` premise shown to be a reading of the exchange or a state of the law, and the process and world families joined by definition.* The groundwork exists (`Becoming.ExchangePremises`: five premises are readings and three are states of the law; `Becoming.Runs`; `Becoming.Interleavings`). That the whole's determinations are internally related moments of one unfolding stays the target's philosophical remainder (chapter §8.5). The chapter's §8.1, item 1, already presents this as the formal part; the target's own wording in the record `theory-of-becoming-foundation` and in GOALS is unchanged.
